conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: You mean Ms. Minyoung took Xiyuan home thinking she was her own child, is that right?
Respondent: I asked her what was going on, and Minyoung told me.
Respondent: She heard someone calling Xiyuan’s name, and only after a lot of effort did she finally find her. She searched all the nearby amusement parks.
Respondent: That boy was probably the child’s older brother. Her older brother told her to wait there for him to come back.
Respondent: It must have been when her older brother called her Xiyuan that Minyoung happened to hear it.
Respondent: I don’t know anything else, but I can roughly guess what happened.
Respondent: I guess she must have naturally brought her back, just like any parent picking up a child.
Respondent: And the child acted as if nothing was wrong, calling Minyoung “Auntie, Auntie.”
Respondent: I’m sorry, truly sorry:
Respondent: I should have called the police right away... It wasn’t until the day you came to our home that I suddenly became afraid...
Respondent: My hands wouldn’t stop shaking... I dialed for quite a while, and when I came to my senses, I realized I had called Xiyuan’s father.
Respondent: I was the one who called and asked Xiyuan’s father for help. I told him that Minyoung seemed to have brought someone else’s child home and asked him to help find the child’s parents.
Respondent: I told the child’s father that I would find a way to distract Minyoung, and then he could take the child away.
Respondent: Although my daughter is not in her right mind, she must not become a criminal who abducts a child...
Respondent: ...I, an old woman, truly have no shame.
Respondent: I know that doing this will bring divine punishment. Before Xiyuan’s father turned himself in:
Respondent: I even thought that I could just pretend none of this had happened and act as if I knew nothing...
Respondent: How could I not realize that this child is also the treasure of her parents’ hearts?
